Name: Splinter Barricade
Description: Sturdy timber palisade that obstructs enemy movement and deals contact splinter damage.

Name: Flare Peg
Description: Erects a sustained flare peg that establishes a localized safe haven of daylight.

Name: Tar Siphon
Description: Mechanical extractor that filters surrounding tar bogs to harvest residual ash embers over time.

Name: Thumper
Description: Tension-loaded seismic trap that catapults intruding enemies backward upon triggering.
